about_the_game:
Story:

After receiving an anonymous 'love' letter, a desire for a new romance sparks within Reina. The mystery of its sender sends her searching for answers at her house party. Three men stand out—each with their own charm, each a potential contender for her heart.

But is the letter from one of them? Or could it hide a darker secret, one that has nothing to do with love at all?

Character:

About:
Unwahrheit is a psychological horror-romance visual novel (otome game). The goal is to help Reina find her new boyfriend and lead her towards a happily ever after. Choose between three of the dateable men and find out who the secret admirer is.

The demo contains around 17,000 words (approximately 40 minutes of gameplay)

Features:

  • Three character routes

  • Dynamic choices that influence the outcome of the narrative, branching story

  • Different character POVS

  • Multiple endings

content_descriptors.notes: depiction or implication of following themes: self-harm, suicide, suggestive sexual themes, violence, sex, sexual assault, drug and alcohol abuse

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8, 10

short_description: After receiving an anonymous 'love' letter, a desire for a new romance sparks within Reina. But where there is a spark, there is fire. Help Reina choose between three romantic paths and lead her to her happily ever after — or an unhappy ever after.
